title: exceptionWait function returning null makes Retryer.call() throw an undocumented NullPointerException (Long auto-unboxing) and abandon retrying
cause: ExceptionWaitStrategy.computeSleepTime returns function.apply((T) cause), a Long, as a primitive long (WaitStrategies.java:390), so a null result from the user Function (allowed: Guava 22 Function.apply is @Nullable) is auto-unboxed and throws NullPointerException. Retryer.call evaluates waitStrategy.computeSleepTime(attempt) at Retryer.java:176, outside the attempt's try/catch; the only surrounding try wraps blockStrategy.block and catches InterruptedException, so the NPE propagates out of call().
trigger: A Retryer built with withWaitStrategy(WaitStrategies.exceptionWait(E.class, fn)), directly or inside WaitStrategies.join(...), where fn returns null for some E instance (e.g. an optional Retry-After hint that is absent, or a Map.get miss); the callable throws such an E, the rejection predicate retries on it and the stop strategy has not stopped yet.
consequence: Retryer.call() (and RetryerCallable.call() / Future.get() via wrap()) throws a raw NullPointerException instead of returning, throwing ExecutionException or RetryException as documented; retrying is abandoned after the first matching failure even though the stop strategy allows more attempts (reproduced with stopAfterAttempt(3) and neverStop(), where attempt 2 would succeed), and the attempt's real exception is not attached as the NPE's cause.
premises: Built against Guava 22.0 (the target build), where com.google.common.base.Function.apply carries @javax.annotation.Nullable on its return value, so a null result honors the user function's interface contract.

Neither the exceptionWait Javadoc nor the WaitStrategy and Retryer.call Javadoc forbids a null function result or documents a NullPointerException; call() documents only a result, ExecutionException and RetryException.

Level 0 reproduction through public API only (RetryerBuilder, WaitStrategies.exceptionWait/join/fixedWait, StopStrategies, RetryListener, Retryer.call, Retryer.wrap) on unmodified source 177b6c9; deterministic, no timing or concurrency involved.
No guard between the site and the caller: Retryer.call has no catch around computeSleepTime, CompositeWaitStrategy sums members without a guard, and RetryerCallable.call only delegates.
